expressions.cue: A performing duo has two members. Write the membership label using 人組, without a final み; do not write a count of two groups. For writing, use kanji or Arabic numerals.
expressions.explanation: 二人組 describes the two members of one group. ふたりぐみ is the model here; ににんぐみ is also documented. Two separate groups would instead be 二組ふたくみ.

expressions.cue: Participants form groups with three people in each. Write the membership label for one group using 人組, without a final み. For writing, use kanji or Arabic numerals.
expressions.explanation: 三人組 tells how many people belong to one group. It says nothing about how many such groups there are.

expressions.cue: In a speaking activity, participants work in pairs. Write the two-person membership label using 人組, without a final み; do not count the pairs. For writing, use kanji or Arabic numerals.
expressions.explanation: 二人組 names the two participants working together. It does not mean two pairs; the number of pairs is not supplied. Both listed readings are accepted, with ふたりぐみ as the model.
